mainEntity.name: What is the process for kitchen countertop replacement with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for kitchen countertop replacement with Hometelligent Inc. begins with an initial consultation and measurement of your existing space. Following material selection, templates are created to ensure a precise fit. The old countertops are then carefully removed, and new ones are installed. We ensure proper sealing and connection of sinks and cooktops. We recommend you clear all items from your existing countertops and surrounding cabinets to facilitate a smooth and efficient removal and installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, measurement, material selection, templating, removal of old countertops, and installation of new ones. Clear your countertops and cabinets for preparation.
